en.text: Now I declare to you, brothers, the Good News which I preached to you, which also you received, in which you also stand,

zhSimplified.text: 弟兄们，我如今把先前所传给你们的福音告诉你们知道；这福音你们也领受了，又靠着站立得住，

zhTraditional.text: 弟兄們，我如今把先前所傳給你們的福音告訴你們知道；這福音你們也領受了，又靠着站立得住，

en.text: by which also you are saved, if you hold firmly the word which I preached to you—unless you believed in vain.

zhSimplified.text: 并且你们若不是徒然相信，能以持守我所传给你们的，就必因这福音得救。

zhTraditional.text: 並且你們若不是徒然相信，能以持守我所傳給你們的，就必因這福音得救。

en.text: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,

zhSimplified.text: 我当日所领受又传给你们的：第一，就是基督照圣经所说，为我们的罪死了，

zhTraditional.text: 我當日所領受又傳給你們的：第一，就是基督照聖經所說，為我們的罪死了，

en.text: that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,

zhSimplified.text: 而且埋葬了；又照圣经所说，第三天复活了，

zhTraditional.text: 而且埋葬了；又照聖經所說，第三天復活了，

en.text: and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve.

zhSimplified.text: 并且显给矶法看，然后显给十二使徒看；

zhTraditional.text: 並且顯給磯法看，然後顯給十二使徒看；

en.text: Then he appeared to over five hundred brothers at once, most of whom remain until now, but some have also fallen asleep.

zhSimplified.text: 后来一时显给五百多弟兄看，其中一大半到如今还在，却也有已经睡了的。

zhTraditional.text: 後來一時顯給五百多弟兄看，其中一大半到如今還在，卻也有已經睡了的。

en.text: Then he appeared to James, then to all the apostles,

zhSimplified.text: 以后显给雅各看，再显给众使徒看，

zhTraditional.text: 以後顯給雅各看，再顯給眾使徒看，

en.text: and last of all, as to the child born at the wrong time, he appeared to me also.

zhSimplified.text: 末了也显给我看；我如同未到产期而生的人一般。

zhTraditional.text: 末了也顯給我看；我如同未到產期而生的人一般。

en.text: For I am the least of the apostles, who is not worthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the assembly of God.

zhSimplified.text: 我原是使徒中最小的，不配称为使徒，因为我从前逼迫 神的教会。

zhTraditional.text: 我原是使徒中最小的，不配稱為使徒，因為我從前逼迫上帝的教會。

en.text: But by the grace of God I am what I am. His grace which was given to me was not futile, but I worked more than all of them; yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.

zhSimplified.text: 然而，我今日成了何等人，是蒙 神的恩才成的，并且他所赐我的恩不是徒然的。我比众使徒格外劳苦；这原不是我，乃是 神的恩与我同在。

zhTraditional.text: 然而，我今日成了何等人，是蒙上帝的恩才成的，並且他所賜我的恩不是徒然的。我比眾使徒格外勞苦；這原不是我，乃是上帝的恩與我同在。

en.text: Whether then it is I or they, so we preach, and so you believed.

zhSimplified.text: 不拘是我，是众使徒，我们如此传，你们也如此信了。

zhTraditional.text: 不拘是我，是眾使徒，我們如此傳，你們也如此信了。

en.text: Now if Christ is preached, that he has been raised from the dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?

zhSimplified.text: 既传基督是从死里复活了，怎么在你们中间有人说没有死人复活的事呢？

zhTraditional.text: 既傳基督是從死裏復活了，怎麼在你們中間有人說沒有死人復活的事呢？

en.text: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, neither has Christ been raised.

zhSimplified.text: 若没有死人复活的事，基督也就没有复活了。

zhTraditional.text: 若沒有死人復活的事，基督也就沒有復活了。

en.text: If Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is in vain and your faith also is in vain.

zhSimplified.text: 若基督没有复活，我们所传的便是枉然，你们所信的也是枉然；

zhTraditional.text: 若基督沒有復活，我們所傳的便是枉然，你們所信的也是枉然；

en.text: Yes, we are also found false witnesses of God, because we testified about God that he raised up Christ, whom he didn’t raise up if it is true that the dead are not raised.

zhSimplified.text: 并且明显我们是为 神妄作见证的，因我们见证 神是叫基督复活了。若死人真不复活， 神也就没有叫基督复活了。

zhTraditional.text: 並且明顯我們是為上帝妄作見證的，因我們見證上帝是叫基督復活了。若死人真不復活，上帝也就沒有叫基督復活了。

en.text: For if the dead aren’t raised, neither has Christ been raised.

zhSimplified.text: 因为死人若不复活，基督也就没有复活了。

zhTraditional.text: 因為死人若不復活，基督也就沒有復活了。

en.text: If Christ has not been raised, your faith is vain; you are still in your sins.

zhSimplified.text: 基督若没有复活，你们的信便是徒然，你们仍在罪里。

zhTraditional.text: 基督若沒有復活，你們的信便是徒然，你們仍在罪裏。

en.text: Then they also who are fallen asleep in Christ have perished.

zhSimplified.text: 就是在基督里睡了的人也灭亡了。

zhTraditional.text: 就是在基督裏睡了的人也滅亡了。

en.text: If we have only hoped in Christ in this life, we are of all men most pitiable.

zhSimplified.text: 我们若靠基督只在今生有指望，就算比众人更可怜。

zhTraditional.text: 我們若靠基督只在今生有指望，就算比眾人更可憐。

en.text: But now Christ has been raised from the dead. He became the first fruit of those who are asleep.

zhSimplified.text: 但基督已经从死里复活，成为睡了之人初熟的果子。

zhTraditional.text: 但基督已經從死裏復活，成為睡了之人初熟的果子。

en.text: For since death came by man, the resurrection of the dead also came by man.

zhSimplified.text: 死既是因一人而来，死人复活也是因一人而来。

zhTraditional.text: 死既是因一人而來，死人復活也是因一人而來。

en.text: For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.

zhSimplified.text: 在亚当里众人都死了；照样，在基督里众人也都要复活。

zhTraditional.text: 在亞當裏眾人都死了；照樣，在基督裏眾人也都要復活。

en.text: But each in his own order: Christ the first fruits, then those who are Christ’s at his coming.

zhSimplified.text: 但各人是按着自己的次序复活：初熟的果子是基督；以后，在他来的时候，是那些属基督的。

zhTraditional.text: 但各人是按着自己的次序復活：初熟的果子是基督；以後，在他來的時候，是那些屬基督的。

en.text: Then the end comes, when he will deliver up the Kingdom to God the Father, when he will have abolished all rule and all authority and power.

zhSimplified.text: 再后，末期到了，那时基督既将一切执政的、掌权的、有能的都毁灭了，就把国交与父 神。

zhTraditional.text: 再後，末期到了，那時基督既將一切執政的、掌權的、有能的都毀滅了，就把國交與父上帝。

en.text: For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.

zhSimplified.text: 因为基督必要作王，等 神把一切仇敌都放在他的脚下。

zhTraditional.text: 因為基督必要作王，等上帝把一切仇敵都放在他的腳下。

en.text: The last enemy that will be abolished is death.

zhSimplified.text: 尽末了所毁灭的仇敌就是死。

zhTraditional.text: 儘末了所毀滅的仇敵就是死。

en.text: For, “He put all things in subjection under his feet.” But when he says, “All things are put in subjection”, it is evident that he is excepted who subjected all things to him.

zhSimplified.text: 因为经上说：「 神叫万物都服在他的脚下。」既说万物都服了他，明显那叫万物服他的，不在其内了。

zhTraditional.text: 因為經上說：「上帝叫萬物都服在他的腳下。」既說萬物都服了他，明顯那叫萬物服他的，不在其內了。

en.text: When all things have been subjected to him, then the Son will also himself be subjected to him who subjected all things to him, that God may be all in all.

zhSimplified.text: 万物既服了他，那时子也要自己服那叫万物服他的，叫 神在万物之上，为万物之主。

zhTraditional.text: 萬物既服了他，那時子也要自己服那叫萬物服他的，叫上帝在萬物之上，為萬物之主。

en.text: Or else what will they do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead aren’t raised at all, why then are they baptized for the dead?

zhSimplified.text: 不然，那些为死人受洗的，将来怎样呢？若死人总不复活，因何为他们受洗呢？

zhTraditional.text: 不然，那些為死人受洗的，將來怎樣呢？若死人總不復活，因何為他們受洗呢？

en.text: Why do we also stand in jeopardy every hour?

zhSimplified.text: 我们又因何时刻冒险呢？

zhTraditional.text: 我們又因何時刻冒險呢？

en.text: I affirm, by the boasting in you which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.

zhSimplified.text: 弟兄们，我在我主基督耶稣里，指着你们所夸的口极力地说，我是天天冒死。

zhTraditional.text: 弟兄們，我在我主基督耶穌裏，指着你們所誇的口極力地說，我是天天冒死。

en.text: If I fought with animals at Ephesus for human purposes, what does it profit me? If the dead are not raised, then “let’s eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”

zhSimplified.text: 我若当日像寻常人，在以弗所同野兽战斗，那于我有什么益处呢？若死人不复活， 我们就吃吃喝喝吧！ 因为明天要死了。

zhTraditional.text: 我若當日像尋常人，在以弗所同野獸戰鬥，那於我有甚麼益處呢？若死人不復活， 我們就吃吃喝喝吧！ 因為明天要死了。

en.text: Don’t be deceived! “Evil companionships corrupt good morals.”

zhSimplified.text: 你们不要自欺；滥交是败坏善行。

zhTraditional.text: 你們不要自欺；濫交是敗壞善行。

en.text: Wake up righteously and don’t sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.

zhSimplified.text: 你们要醒悟为善，不要犯罪，因为有人不认识 神。我说这话是要叫你们羞愧。

zhTraditional.text: 你們要醒悟為善，不要犯罪，因為有人不認識上帝。我說這話是要叫你們羞愧。

en.text: But someone will say, “How are the dead raised?” and, “With what kind of body do they come?”

zhSimplified.text: 或有人问：「死人怎样复活，带着什么身体来呢？」

zhTraditional.text: 或有人問：「死人怎樣復活，帶着甚麼身體來呢？」

en.text: You foolish one, that which you yourself sow is not made alive unless it dies.

zhSimplified.text: 无知的人哪，你所种的，若不死就不能生。

zhTraditional.text: 無知的人哪，你所種的，若不死就不能生。

en.text: That which you sow, you don’t sow the body that will be, but a bare grain, maybe of wheat, or of some other kind.

zhSimplified.text: 并且你所种的不是那将来的形体，不过是子粒，即如麦子，或是别样的谷。

zhTraditional.text: 並且你所種的不是那將來的形體，不過是子粒，即如麥子，或是別樣的穀。

en.text: But God gives it a body even as it pleased him, and to each seed a body of its own.

zhSimplified.text: 但 神随自己的意思给他一个形体，并叫各等子粒各有自己的形体。

zhTraditional.text: 但上帝隨自己的意思給他一個形體，並叫各等子粒各有自己的形體。

en.text: All flesh is not the same flesh, but there is one flesh of men, another flesh of animals, another of fish, and another of birds.

zhSimplified.text: 凡肉体各有不同：人是一样，兽又是一样，鸟又是一样，鱼又是一样。

zhTraditional.text: 凡肉體各有不同：人是一樣，獸又是一樣，鳥又是一樣，魚又是一樣。

en.text: There are also celestial bodies and terrestrial bodies; but the glory of the celestial differs from that of the terrestrial.

zhSimplified.text: 有天上的形体，也有地上的形体；但天上形体的荣光是一样，地上形体的荣光又是一样。

zhTraditional.text: 有天上的形體，也有地上的形體；但天上形體的榮光是一樣，地上形體的榮光又是一樣。

en.text: There is one glory of the sun, another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for one star differs from another star in glory.

zhSimplified.text: 日有日的荣光，月有月的荣光，星有星的荣光；这星和那星的荣光也有分别。

zhTraditional.text: 日有日的榮光，月有月的榮光，星有星的榮光；這星和那星的榮光也有分別。

en.text: So also is the resurrection of the dead. The body is sown perishable; it is raised imperishable.

zhSimplified.text: 死人复活也是这样：所种的是必朽坏的，复活的是不朽坏的；

zhTraditional.text: 死人復活也是這樣：所種的是必朽壞的，復活的是不朽壞的；

en.text: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.

zhSimplified.text: 所种的是羞辱的，复活的是荣耀的；所种的是软弱的，复活的是强壮的；

zhTraditional.text: 所種的是羞辱的，復活的是榮耀的；所種的是軟弱的，復活的是強壯的；

en.text: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body and there is also a spiritual body.

zhSimplified.text: 所种的是血气的身体，复活的是灵性的身体。若有血气的身体，也必有灵性的身体。

zhTraditional.text: 所種的是血氣的身體，復活的是靈性的身體。若有血氣的身體，也必有靈性的身體。

en.text: So also it is written, “The first man Adam became a living soul.” The last Adam became a life-giving spirit.

zhSimplified.text: 经上也是这样记着说：「首先的人亚当成了有灵的活人」；末后的亚当成了叫人活的灵。

zhTraditional.text: 經上也是這樣記着說：「首先的人亞當成了有靈的活人」；末後的亞當成了叫人活的靈。

en.text: However, that which is spiritual isn’t first, but that which is natural, then that which is spiritual.

zhSimplified.text: 但属灵的不在先，属血气的在先，以后才有属灵的。

zhTraditional.text: 但屬靈的不在先，屬血氣的在先，以後才有屬靈的。

en.text: The first man is of the earth, made of dust. The second man is the Lord from heaven.

zhSimplified.text: 头一个人是出于地，乃属土；第二个人是出于天。

zhTraditional.text: 頭一個人是出於地，乃屬土；第二個人是出於天。

en.text: As is the one made of dust, such are those who are also made of dust; and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.

zhSimplified.text: 那属土的怎样，凡属土的也就怎样；属天的怎样，凡属天的也就怎样。

zhTraditional.text: 那屬土的怎樣，凡屬土的也就怎樣；屬天的怎樣，凡屬天的也就怎樣。

en.text: As we have borne the image of those made of dust, let’s also bear the image of the heavenly.

footnotes.text: 15:49 NU, TR read “we will” instead of “let’s”

zhSimplified.text: 我们既有属土的形状，将来也必有属天的形状。

zhTraditional.text: 我們既有屬土的形狀，將來也必有屬天的形狀。

en.text: Now I say this, brothers, that flesh and blood can’t inherit God’s Kingdom; neither does the perishable inherit imperishable.

footnotes.text: 15:50 The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.”

zhSimplified.text: 弟兄们，我告诉你们说，血肉之体不能承受 神的国，必朽坏的不能承受不朽坏的。

zhTraditional.text: 弟兄們，我告訴你們說，血肉之體不能承受上帝的國，必朽壞的不能承受不朽壞的。

en.text: Behold, I tell you a mystery. We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed,

footnotes.text: 15:51 “Behold”, from “ἰδοὺ”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

zhSimplified.text: 我如今把一件奥秘的事告诉你们：我们不是都要睡觉，乃是都要改变，

zhTraditional.text: 我如今把一件奧祕的事告訴你們：我們不是都要睡覺，乃是都要改變，

en.text: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound and the dead will be raised incorruptible, and we will be changed.

zhSimplified.text: 就在一霎时，眨眼之间，号筒末次吹响的时候。因号筒要响，死人要复活成为不朽坏的，我们也要改变。

zhTraditional.text: 就在一霎時，眨眼之間，號筒末次吹響的時候。因號筒要響，死人要復活成為不朽壞的，我們也要改變。

en.text: For this perishable body must become imperishable, and this mortal must put on immortality.

zhSimplified.text: 这必朽坏的总要变成不朽坏的，这必死的总要变成不死的。

zhTraditional.text: 這必朽壞的總要變成不朽壞的，這必死的總要變成不死的。

en.text: But when this perishable body will have become imperishable, and this mortal will have put on immortality, then what is written will happen: “Death is swallowed up in victory.”

zhSimplified.text: 这必朽坏的既变成不朽坏的，这必死的既变成不死的，那时经上所记「死被得胜吞灭」的话就应验了。

zhTraditional.text: 這必朽壞的既變成不朽壞的，這必死的既變成不死的，那時經上所記「死被得勝吞滅」的話就應驗了。

en.text: “Death, where is your sting? Hades, where is your victory?”

zhSimplified.text: 死啊！你得胜的权势在哪里？ 死啊！你的毒钩在哪里？

zhTraditional.text: 死啊！你得勝的權勢在哪裏？ 死啊！你的毒鉤在哪裏？

en.text: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.

zhSimplified.text: 死的毒钩就是罪，罪的权势就是律法。

zhTraditional.text: 死的毒鉤就是罪，罪的權勢就是律法。

en.text: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

zhSimplified.text: 感谢 神，使我们借着我们的主耶稣基督得胜。

zhTraditional.text: 感謝上帝，使我們藉着我們的主耶穌基督得勝。

en.text: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.

zhSimplified.text: 所以，我亲爱的弟兄们，你们务要坚固，不可摇动，常常竭力多做主工；因为知道，你们的劳苦在主里面不是徒然的。

zhTraditional.text: 所以，我親愛的弟兄們，你們務要堅固，不可搖動，常常竭力多做主工；因為知道，你們的勞苦在主裏面不是徒然的。
